scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run check:contrast && npm run build -w @optcg/app && npm run check:bundle
scripts.test:lethal: LETHAL_GAMES=24 LETHAL_NODES=60000 LETHAL_POSITIONS=160 LETHAL_HANDS=4 vitest run ai/test/lethal-games.test.ts ai/test/lethal-sound.test.ts
scripts.test:strength: npm run test:strength:m5b && npm run test:strength:pirate
scripts.test:strength:pirate: STRENGTH_GAMES=200 SHALLOW_GAMES=100 PLAN_GAMES=40 AB_GAMES=40 EXTRA=1 vitest run ai/test/strength.test.ts ai/test/game-plan-g2.test.ts ai/test/game-plan-g3.test.ts
scripts.test:timing: TIMING=1 REVIEW_GATE=1 vitest run ai/test/budget.test.ts ai/test/hint.test.ts ai/test/review-gate.test.ts app/test/usability-s2.test.ts
scripts.test:plan-warlord: PLAN_TIER=warlord PLAN_GAMES=${PLAN_GAMES:-40} PLAN_GAMES_G1=${PLAN_GAMES_G1:-64} vitest run ai/test/strength.test.ts ai/test/game-plan-g1.test.ts ai/test/game-plan-g2.test.ts ai/test/game-plan-g3.test.ts -t 'game-plan assertions|game plans'
scripts.perf: npm run perf:lighthouse && npm run perf:frames
scripts.licences: if [ -e scripts/licences.ts ]; then tsx scripts/licences.ts; else echo 'licences: not built yet'; fi
scripts.a11y:sheet: if [ -e scripts/a11y-sheet.ts ]; then tsx scripts/a11y-sheet.ts; else echo 'a11y:sheet: not built yet'; fi
scripts.test:visual: if [ -e app/e2e/visual ]; then VISUAL=1 playwright test app/e2e/visual; else echo 'test:visual: not built yet'; fi
scripts.test:audit: if [ -e app/e2e/m10-audit.spec.ts ]; then playwright test app/e2e/m10-audit.spec.ts; else echo 'test:audit: not built yet'; fi
